title: SalivaDirect™: RNA extraction-free SARS-CoV-2 diagnostics
author: Chantal Vogels
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.btdnni5e
materials: Ensure all collection materials are labelled with the correct identifying information.

While preparing collection materials, direct the sample provider to begin pooling saliva in their mouth. Saliva production can be stimulated by thinking about food (favorite foods, upcoming meals, etc.) or about the saliva collection itself. This protocol is intended for the collection of the normal saliva that naturally pools into the mouth. No coughing or sniffing prior to sample collection is required. Ideally, water should be avoided 10 minutes prior to collection. Other drinks, food, and nasal sprays should be avoided for half an hour before sample collection.
Inactivate the proteinase K by heating samples for 5 minutes at 95°C on a PCR instrument or equivalent thermocycler.

For the Agilent AriaMX : After loading the plate in the thermocycler, place a compression pad securely on the top of the plate and assure the position is aligned with the plate. On the AriaMX screen select “graphical displays” and then adjust or confirm that the Cycle Range for Background Based Threshold is: “8 thru 12”.

On ice, prepare a master mix from one of the approved vendors containing the following (account for 10% extra lost during pipetting), excluding processed saliva or controls: Component NEB Luna (2x) NEB Luna 4X Bio-Rad Reliance Thermo TaqPath Master mix 5 µL 2.5 µL 2.5 µL 2.5 µL RT 0.5 µL - - - Primer-probe-water mix (see Table 9) 2 µL 2 µL 2 µL 2 µL Nuclease-free water - 3 µL 3 µL 3 µL PK-treated sample or control 2.5 µL (do not add to master mix) 2.5 µL (do not add to master mix) 2.5 µL (do not add to master mix) 2.5 µL (do not add to master mix)

steps.title: Collect Saliva Sample
steps.instruction: Collect at least 0.5 mL of saliva from the provider into a collection container.

substeps.instruction: Clean hands with alcohol-based sanitizer or soap and water (no fragrances) and don PPE (gloves and mask).
Remove the lid of the collection container and have the provider gently expel saliva until at least 0.5 mL is collected (excluding bubbles).
Securely replace the lid.
Sterilize the container surface with 70% ethanol or a disinfecting wipe.
Place the sample in a secondary container or labeled biohazard bag.
Dispose of gloves and register the sample collection date and time.

steps.title: Sample Storage and Transport
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to the laboratory for processing.

substeps.instruction: If processing (aliquoting) will exceed 6 hours, store samples at 2-8°C for up to 7 days or at -80°C for long-term storage.
Thaw samples on ice before testing if they were frozen.

steps.title: Prepare Primer and Probe Stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare 20 µM working stocks of primers and probes.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL of 100 µM stock to 80 µL nuclease-free water.
Briefly vortex and centrifuge reagents.
Store probes in the dark as they are photosensitive.

steps.title: Prepare Dualplex Primer-Probe-Water Mix
steps.instruction: Create a primer-probe-water mix using the 20 µM working stocks.

substeps.instruction: For 1 reaction, combine: 2019-nCoV_N1-F (0.4 µL), 2019-nCoV_N1-R (0.4 µL), 2019-nCoV_N1-P (0.2 µL), RP-F (0.15 µL), RP-R (0.15 µL), RP-P (0.2 µL), and Nuclease-free water (2.5 µL).
For 100 reactions, combine: 2019-nCoV_N1-F (40 µL), 2019-nCoV_N1-R (40 µL), 2019-nCoV_N1-P (20 µL), RP-F (15 µL), RP-R (15 µL), RP-P (20 µL), and Nuclease-free water (250 µL).
Optional: Aliquot larger volumes in LightSafe microcentrifuge tubes and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix (accounting for 10% extra volume) excluding the processed saliva or control.

substeps.instruction: Select one vendor mix: NEB Luna (2x) [10 µL mix, 1 µL RT, 4 µL primer-probe-water mix], Bio-Rad Reliance [5 µL mix, 4 µL primer-probe-water mix, 6 µL nuclease-free water], or Thermo TaqPath [5 µL mix, 4 µL primer-probe-water mix, 6 µL nuclease-free water].

steps.title: Process Saliva Samples
steps.instruction: Perform sample pre-treatment based on the selected workflow (BSL-2 conditions in a biosafety cabinet).

substeps.instruction: For Proteinase K treatment: Add Proteinase K to 200 µL 8-strip PCR tubes (ThermoFisher MagMAX 50 mg/mL: 2.5 µL; NEB 20 mg/mL: 6.25 µL; AmericanBio Lyophilized 50 mg/mL: 2.5 µL).
Vortex saliva until homogeneous and transfer 50 µL to the Proteinase K tube. Add 50 µL nuclease-free water to one tube as a negative extraction control.
Close lids tightly, vortex for 1 minute at 3000-5000 RPM, and briefly spin down.
For Heat treatment: Incubate samples at 65°C for 15 minutes, 95°C for 5 minutes, OR 95°C for 30 minutes (use heat-stable tubes/labels).
Vortex samples and proceed to RT-qPCR or store at -80°C.

steps.title: Load qPCR Plate
steps.instruction: Add processed samples and master mix to the PCR plate on a cooler.

substeps.instruction: For 96-well plates: Add 15 µL master mix per well. Add 5 µL processed saliva (including negative extraction control), 5 µL positive control (Twist synthetic SARS-CoV-2 RNA, 100 copies/µL), and 5 µL NTC (water).
For 384-well plates: Add 7.5 µL master mix per well. Add 2.5 µL processed saliva (including negative extraction control), 2.5 µL positive control (100 copies/µL), and 2.5 µL NTC (water).
Mix by pipetting (avoid bubbles). If using heat-treatment without Proteinase K, vortex vigorously and briefly centrifuge before adding to the plate.
Seal with transparent plastic qPCR seal and centrifuge briefly to remove bubbles.

steps.title: Run qPCR and Interpret Results
steps.instruction: Run the thermocycler on standard mode and interpret Ct values.

substeps.instruction: Thermocycler conditions: 52°C for 10 min, 95°C for 2 min, then 44 cycles of [95°C for 10 sec, 55°C for 30 sec, Read FAM & Cy5].
For ABI 7500 Fast Dx: Manually set threshold to 100,000 for N1 and 10,000 for RP.
Interpretation: Positive if N1 Ct < 40.0 (any RP value); Negative if N1 Ct ≥ 40.0 and RP Ct < 35.0; Invalid if N1 Ct ≥ 40.0 and RP Ct ≥ 35.0.
